query:
INSERT INTO prayer_log (user_id, prayer_date, prayer, status, prayed_at)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'prayed', ?)
         ON CONFLICT (user_id, prayer_date, prayer) DO UPDATE
         SET status = 'late', prayed_at = excluded.prayed_at
         WHERE prayer_log.status = 'missed'
         RETURNING status
